items.name: Horn of the Hunt
items.lore: A small, curling horn of black bone. The hounds know whoever carries it.

items.name: Cwn Annwn Collar
items.lore: A red leather collar with a silver bell. The bell does not ring.

items.name: Harper's Cord
items.lore: Strung with old harp strings, each one tuned.

items.name: Nest's Shawl
items.lore: Thick Welsh wool, red and black. She made it for Iolo's wedding gift.

items.name: Abbot's Psalter Charm
items.lore: A single vellum page in a silver case. The psalm on it is for the dead.

items.name: Vigil Cloak
items.lore: A monk's heavy brown cloak. Ghosts of soldiers once stood watch over it.

items.name: Evocatus' Ring
items.lore: A veteran soldier's ring, bearing the mark of a legion long gone.

items.name: Copyist's Bracer
items.lore: Ink-stained leather. The abbey's copyists wore them for three hundred years.
